# IJFMR - International Journal For Multidisciplinary Research

> A UGC-recommended, peer-reviewed open-access multidisciplinary journal providing a platform for researchers to publish high-quality academic work across diverse disciplines.

IJFMR is a bi-monthly international journal following UGC guidelines with a comprehensive submission and publication process. The journal accepts regular research papers, conference proceedings, and special issues across multiple research areas with a focus on publication ethics and rigorous peer review standards.

## Key Topics

- Peer-reviewed journal
- Open-access publishing
- Multidisciplinary research
- Academic publishing
- Publication ethics
- Peer review process
- Conference proceedings
- Research paper submission
- UGC guidelines
- CoPE compliance
- E-ISSN: 2582-2160
- Journal submission
- Publication guidelines
- Plagiarism detection
- Academic standards
